input.rationale: The Agreement contains no express performance warranty anywhere. Article VII obliges Licensor only to use "commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections" (p0093) and to make Revisions available (p0094), which is a support covenant rather than a warranty, and Article VIX provides the Licensed Technology wholly "AS IS" with all warranties express and implied disclaimed, including any warranty that the technology is error-free, will meet Licensee's requirements, or that nonconformity to its Documentation can or will be corrected (p0110-p0116). That is the playbook's walk-away position: full "AS IS" with no conformance warranty and no remedy, so it fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund). Redline inserts the preferred express warranty (workmanlike services, 12-month conformance to Documentation, no malicious code, compliance with laws) with a repair/replace/refund remedy and carves it out of the disclaimer; the fallback 90-day period is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert an express performance warranty (12 months software conformance / workmanlike services, no malicious code, legal compliance) with repair-replace-refund remedy, and carve it out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly "AS IS" with every warranty disclaimed, so we have no contractual recourse if the platform fails to work as documented. We have added a standard express warranty (workmanlike services, twelve-month conformance to Documentation, no malicious code, compliance with law) with a repair, replace or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer; we can accept a ninety (90) day conformance period if a shorter window is needed.
